hooks.name: HoneyPass border guard (tool calls)
hooks.description: Dev-time guard: blocks secret-path access, non-allowlisted egress, pipe-to-shell, force-push, --no-verify, and commits during the challenge freeze window. Exit code 2 blocks the tool call.

hooks.name: HoneyPass border guard (prompts)
hooks.description: Blocks prompts that contain pasted secrets (AWS access keys, private keys).
